resources.string: Only while the MokaBot\'s network button shows Bluetooth. The first time, type the PIN shown on the MokaBot\'s screen. Connects to the last MokaBot used, or lists them when several are in reach.
Searching for MokaBots on the WiFi network…
No MokaBot answered on this WiFi network. Is the phone on the same network?
WiFi: type the address shown on the MokaBot\'s network button (e.g. 192.168.1.40). The IP always works; mokabot.local does not on some phones and browsers.
No MokaBot found over Bluetooth. Is it switched on and nearby?
Type the PIN shown on the MokaBot\'s screen when the phone asks. If no PIN is asked for, pair once in the phone\'s Bluetooth settings (MokaBot), then connect here again.
The phone could not find %1$s. Use the IP shown on the MokaBot\'s network button instead.
Is the phone on the same WiFi as the MokaBot, and does its network button show a WiFi address?
